keyReconciliation.h1439GlobalSimulationDifference: H14.39 treats one event ID as global across all simulated profiles; V30.3.85C correctly scopes uniqueness to a verified subject. Future agreement should follow V30.3.85C for distinct verified subjects.

transactionDesign.existingSql: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT(learner_subject,event_id) DO NOTHING then READ_AND_COMPARE
transactionDesign.integrity: canonical JSON SHA256 and read verification; no authority inferred from digest alone
transactionDesign.restart: 85C file-backed SQLite test confirms records survive connection close/open
transactionDesign.crashBetweenInsertAndResponse: Retry SAME UUID, compare record, return same result (not second write)
transactionDesign.crashBetweenPendingAndEvaluation: NO_EVIDENCE_GRANTED; future authorized evaluator must own its own transactional exactly-once evidence/outbox contract
transactionDesign.concurrency: SQLite unique index is modeled/tested; Cloudflare D1 distributed concurrency and Worker retries not yet independently verified
transactionDesign.rollback: Disable new adapter without deleting prior tables or historical data
transactionDesign.privacy: No real user answers, sessions, NICK, or credentials in this research branch
